definitions.name: powerSteps
definitions.outside_source: All real alpha and all natural s are defined. Only positivity, not decay, is claimed for arbitrary alpha.

definitions.name: phi
definitions.matching: Literal rational/real-power expression agrees on all of source (0,1), with no zero denominator there. The range is a theorem obligation, not part of the input carrier.
definitions.outside_source: Lean total division defines off-source values, including phi(1)=1. REJECT any claim of global literal equality to the source partial function or phi(1)=1-log(2). Restriction suffices for the accepted Anchor statements and left-limit germ.

definitions.name: switchSlope
definitions.source_carrier: Integer admissible T and source rounds 1..T
definitions.matching: s<(T+1) div 2 means source round s+1<=ceil(T/2).
definitions.outside_source: Extends the stream to all natural times; T=0 gives all positive signs. No zero-horizon source theorem or common all-horizon witness inferred.

definitions.name: switchLoss
definitions.source_carrier: R or R^d with coordinate direction e_1, finite source prefix
definitions.lean_carrier: Any real inner-product E, any direction v, all T,s
definitions.matching: v=1 in R yields -x/+x; v=e_1 yields source first-coordinate loss. Unit vectors give an isometric direction generalization.
definitions.outside_source: Arbitrary v need not produce 1-Lipschitz losses; unit norm is required in the regularity/helper theorem, then chosen within main existential proof.

recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.name: SourceSubdifferential
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.expansion: Membership g iff for every y, f(x)+<g,y-x><=f(y). Source properness is automatic for the actual finite-real losses.
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.audit: Generic extended-real off-source arithmetic is not certified. No properness or nonemptiness proof is a public Anchor input.

recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.name: Domain and fullSpace
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.expansion: Domain has carrier, nonempty, closed and convex fields. fullSpace sets carrier=univ and supplies all three elementary certificates.
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.classification: STANDING for source algorithm conventions; certificates internally discharged. No boundedness, diameter, confidence or regret field.

recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.name: project
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.expansion: Classical.choose of exists v in V.carrier, norm(z-v)=inf norm(z-w). Nonemptiness/closedness/convexity come from Domain; completeness from finite Euclidean typing.
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.audit: The exact supplied witness type resolves the earlier missing-context issue. For univ, z is feasible and the nonnegative infimum is zero, so chosen point is z and unique. This is semantic reasoning, not a separately compiled proof. General-domain uniqueness certification is outside this target and is not inferred from the existential header alone.

recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.name: currentSubgradient
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.expansion: If the global subdifferential is nonempty choose a member, else return zero.
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.audit: Reject blanket source characterization on all EReal functions: fallback is off-source. Actual affine witnesses have unique slope, hence nonempty subdifferential and no fallback. Finite convex real losses in the main existential conclusion also have subgradients everywhere in finite dimension; proof of required witness facts must be in later dependencies, never an added public binder. No unique choice is required by source OSD for general nondifferentiable losses.

recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.name: step
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.expansion: project V (x-eta*currentSubgradient f x). On fullSpace this is the source unprojected step. Positive source eta is generated by powerSteps, not assumed via a bound certificate.
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.audit: Generic eta<=0 outside source algorithm is allowed in B helper identities only.

recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.name: iterate
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.audit: Current loss is used after the point scored in that round; no future-loss dependency in recursion.

recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.name: regret
recursively_expanded_supporting_definiti.audit: Every target loss is a real value embedded in EReal, so toReal recovers that real value. Both x1 and u equal zero in source lower bounds. No best-comparator, expectation, or infinite-loss semantics are certified.
